items.title: Realising two inverse systems of derived objects by a bi-filtered complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma extends the realisation of an inverse system by a filtered complex to the case of two inverse systems mapping compatibly to the same object, producing a bi-filtered complex (statement lines 2705-2713). The proof is a complete argument: the one-system case is applied twice (proof lines 2715-2722); the two resulting complexes are mapped into their product by termwise injective quasi-isomorphisms, the product representing the object because products in the derived category are termwise products of K-injective complexes (proof lines 2722-2732); and the images of the two filtrations give the required bi-filtration (proof lines 2732-2735). The non-formal content is the transport of the two filtrations. The claim is H2.
